title.en: MALACANAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXEMPTING THE NATIONAL HOUSING AUTHORITY FROM THE NATIONAL ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY GUIDELINES ON JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENTS IMPLEMENTATION RECOVERY, RECONSTRUCTION AND REHABILITATION PROJECTS IN THE MOST AFFECTED AREAS OF MARAWI CITY

text.en:
Exempting the NHA from the NDA Guidelines on Joint Venture
Agreements. To expedite the recovery, reconstruction and rehabilitation efforts in Marawi
City currently being undertaken by national government agencies led by the HUDCC, the
NHA, as an agency attached to the HUDCC, is hereby exempted from the NEDA Guidelines
on JVAs, subject to the parameters stated in Section 2 hereof.

NHA Authority to Issue Guidelines. All JVAs to be entered into by the
NHA pursuant to this Order shall comply with Guidelines which the NHA shall formulate and
issue under the supervision of the HUDCC and in consultation with the NEDA, the Public-
Private Partnership Center, and the Department of Budget and Management.
Such guidelines shall (a) apply only to recovery, reconstruction and rehabilitation
proiects for the most affected areas of Marawi City; (b) promote efficiency, transparency,
competitiveness and accountability in covered transactions; (c) require the participation of
agencies with mandates directly relevant to the project in the JVA selection and contracting
process; and (d) be consistent with all applicable laws, rules and regulations.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila this5th day of February in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Eighteen.
By the President:
